name: Hayama Kouichi
source:
"Don't worry, a noisy little hedgehog like you is the last thing I want."

The protagonist of this story.
A heavy smoker with a cynical attitude, he’s a university student in Tokyo, belonging to the folklore studies department. Raised by adoptive parents, he’s been told that he once stayed at the main Kuraki family household as a child, though he remembers almost nothing of that time. He suffers from a mysterious condition that prevents him from recognizing women's faces, and he is plagued by strange nightmares.

[From the [url=https://aridesign.co.jp/root/nsmr/character.html]official site[/url].]
